description_en: Queries enterprise-level snapshot policies by specifying parameters such as PolicyIds, ResourceGroupId, and Tag

kebab_example: aliyun ebs describe-enterprise-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-ids esp-xxx --disk-ids d-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmvs0000 --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --max-results 100 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --tag Value=tag-value Key=tag-key --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy
